metadata.title: Rust WASM Instrumentation Schema — Autonomic Healing Observability
metadata.architecture: Three new OTEL span types for RL convergence diagnostics, SPC rule classification, and circuit decision impact
metadata.emission_frequency: Periodic (every N cycles) + on-demand (SPC violation, circuit transition)

rl_convergence_diagnostics.category: RL Learning Stability (Category B: Policy Improvement)
rl_convergence_diagnostics.oracle_type: Rank-1 Mathematical (Bellman equation) + Rank-4 Statistical (convergence trends)

trigger_conditions: On Q-divergence detection (max_q growth > 50% in 50-sample window)

rl_convergence_diagnostics.description: Diagnostic span for RL agent learning convergence tracking. Emits TD error monotonicity metrics, Q-value divergence signals, weight norm deltas, and learning rate schedule status. Evidence layer for proving agent is learning (not stuck) per Rank-4 statistical oracle (convergence trends over N trials).

semantic_meaning.rank_1_theorem: Bellman equation: Q(s,a) = R(s,a) + γ max_a' Q(s',a'). When α ∈ (0,1) and γ ∈ (0,1), TD error monotonically decreases. Violations indicate oscillation or divergence risk.
semantic_meaning.rank_4_property: After 50 cycles, mean(TD_errors[last_10]) should be < mean(TD_errors[first_10]). Convergence ratio = mean(last) / mean(first) should approach <1.0.
semantic_meaning.chicago_tdd_binding: Event log evidence: each span emission is a timestamped fact. Aggregate spans over 100+ cycles → convergence trajectory. No convergence trajectory = no learning occurred (self-referential falsification blocked).
semantic_meaning.failure_detection: TD error monotonicity violations ≥20% in 50-sample window, Q-value growth >50%, weight deltas consistently near zero, learning rate decay stalled

status.semantics: ok = convergence nominal, warning = borderline (ratio 0.8-1.0), error = divergence risk (ratio >1.0 or violations >20%)

cycle_count.description: Absolute cycle number (0-indexed) when span emitted

td_error_mean.description: Mean TD error over latest 50-sample window. Bellman target quality metric.

td_error_convergence_ratio.description: Ratio of mean(TD_errors[last_10]) / mean(TD_errors[first_10]). Should approach <1.0 over time.

td_error_monotonicity_violations.description: Count of samples in latest 50-window where error[i] > error[i-1] (upward spike). Should be <5 per 50 samples (10%).

max_q_value.description: Maximum Q-value across all agents at cycle. Bellman target bound validation (Rank-1: should be finite and <100).

max_q_divergence_growth_pct.description: Percentage growth of max_q in latest 50-cycle window: (max_q_now - max_q_50cycles_ago) / max_q_50cycles_ago * 100. Should stay <50% for stability.

linucb_active_agent.description: Name of active LinUCB-selected agent at this cycle.

linucb_weight_norm_active_agent.description: L2 norm of weight vector for active agent. Per-agent convergence: weight_norm should increase then stabilize.

linucb_weight_delta_samples.description: Weight delta (|norm_after - norm_before|) for all 5 agents in last 10 cycles. Proves learning activity per Rank-4 oracle.

linucb_convergence_signals.description: Convergence signal per agent: 'learning' if weight_delta > 0.001, 'stable' if 0.0001-0.001, 'stuck' if <0.0001.

learning_rate_current.description: Current learning rate at this cycle: α_t = 0.1 × (0.9999 ^ cycle_count). Rank-1 decay schedule verification.

reward_mean_window.description: Mean cumulative reward over latest 100-cycle window. Should trend positive in stable environment (Domain Contract Rank-2).

cumulative_reward_total.description: Total cumulative reward from cycle 0 to current. Monotonically increasing (or decreasing) path shows policy effectiveness.

reward_outliers_count.description: Count of reward samples >5σ from mean in latest 100 samples. Should be <2 (normal distribution tail).

health_improvement_rate.description: Fraction of cycles where health improved (decreased, since 0=healthy) in latest 50 cycles. Domain Contract: >0.4 in stable environment.

action_success_distribution.description: Per-action success rates over latest 100 actions.

stability_alarm_triggered.description: True if RlStabilityMonitor::is_stable() returned false at this cycle. Signals multi-dimensional stability check failure.

alarm_reason.description: Human-readable reason why stability alarm triggered (if triggered). Examples: 'td_error_oscillation', 'q_divergence_detected', 'weight_norm_explosion', 'reward_outliers_excessive'

stability_check_results.description: Boolean results of all 5 stability checks (TdErrorStats, QValueDivergence, LearningCurveSmooth, RewardScaling, LearningRateDecay)

jaeger_query_pattern.description: How to extract convergence evidence from Jaeger for Chicago TDD Rank-4 oracle validation

query_examples.name: Convergence Trend Over 100 Cycles
query_examples.extraction: Group by cycle_count ASC, extract [td_error_convergence_ratio, max_q_divergence_growth_pct] → plot convergence trajectory
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-4: if mean(convergence_ratio[cycles_50-100]) < 0.8 AND mean(convergence_ratio[cycles_0-50]) > 0.95, then convergence proven

query_examples.name: TD Error Monotonicity Violations
query_examples.extraction: Extract td_error_monotonicity_violations per span → aggregate over 10 cycles (samples per span = 1) → violation % = violations / total_samples
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-1: if violations % <= 10%, Bellman oscillation risk is minimal

query_examples.name: Q-Value Divergence Detection
query_examples.jaeger_query: service.name:wpm AND span.name:"rl.convergence_diagnostics" AND max_q_value AND max_q_divergence_growth_pct
query_examples.extraction: Extract [max_q_value, max_q_divergence_growth_pct] per cycle → identify spans where max_q_divergence_growth_pct > 50
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-1 Bellman bound: if any cycle has max_q_divergence_growth_pct > 50%, divergence alarm valid; if all cycles < 50%, Bellman targets bounded

query_examples.name: Learning Stall Detection
query_examples.extraction: Extract linucb_convergence_signals array per span → count 'stuck' occurrences over last 10 spans
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-4: if >50% of agents report 'stuck' status for >20 consecutive cycles, learning has stalled

query_examples.name: Weight Norm Convergence Per Agent
query_examples.jaeger_query: service.name:wpm AND span.name:"rl.convergence_diagnostics" AND linucb_weight_delta_samples AND linucb_active_agent
query_examples.extraction: Extract linucb_weight_delta_samples + agent name per cycle → plot weight delta trajectory per agent
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-4: if weight_delta converges (mean of last 10 deltas << mean of first 10 deltas), agent learning has converged

rank_1_oracle_proof.statement: For Q-Learning with α ∈ (0,1), γ ∈ (0,1), if rewards are bounded R ∈ [-5.5, +1.6], then Q-values converge to Q* and TD error → 0.
rank_1_oracle_proof.wasm_binding: TD error (r + γ·max_q(s') - Q(s,a)) must have mean(last_10) / mean(first_10) < 1.0 over 100-cycle horizon
rank_1_oracle_proof.span_proof: td_error_mean, td_error_convergence_ratio, max_q_value attributes provide arithmetic evidence that Bellman equation is satisfied

rank_4_oracle_proof.statement: After 50 cycles with constant environment, cumulative_reward trend should be increasing. Mean reward should exceed initial episodes.
rank_4_oracle_proof.wasm_binding: Run 5 independent orchestrator instances with different RNG seeds. Each should emit rl.convergence_diagnostics spans. Across all 5 seeds, mean(reward_window[cycles_50-100]) > mean(reward_window[cycles_0-50])
rank_4_oracle_proof.span_proof: reward_mean_window attribute captures rolling mean. Jaeger query aggregates across seeds → statistical significance test

fm5_prevention.risk: Self-referential span design that derives expected values from implementation logic
fm5_prevention.blocked_pattern: Do NOT include span attributes that compute expected_convergence_ratio from learning_rate formula, then assert actual == expected
fm5_prevention.correct_approach: Include raw metrics (td_error_mean, max_q_value) from execution. Oracle is external (Bellman theorem), not implementation-derived.
fm5_prevention.validation: TD error samples collected during WASM execution; convergence ratio is mathematical property of those samples, not code-internal logic

spc_rule_classification_and_action.category: SPC Timeseries Analysis (Category C: SPC Time-Series)
spc_rule_classification_and_action.oracle_type: Rank-1 Mathematical (Western Electric rules) + Rank-2 Domain Contract (SPC → reward mapping)

trigger_conditions: Western Electric Rule 1: 1 point >3σ from control line
Western Electric Rule 2: 9 consecutive points on same side of control line
Western Electric Rule 3: 6 consecutive points increasing or decreasing
Any rule violation → emit immediately (not buffered)

sampling_window.metric_history: Ring buffer, last 100 control chart points (duration ~ 100 cycles or 1 hour real-time)
sampling_window.baseline_statistics: μ (mean) and σ (std dev) computed from first 30 cycles

spc_rule_classification_and_action.description: Span emitted each time an SPC rule violation (Western Electric rules 1, 2, 3) is detected. Captures which rule fired, which metric (event_rate, trace_duration, activity_frequency), trigger evidence (z-score, point count), and consequent RL reward penalty. Evidence layer for proving SPC detection causality per Rank-1 oracle (rule equations are mathematical theorems).

semantic_meaning.rank_1_theorem: Western Electric Rule 1: P(single point >3σ) = 0.27% under normal distribution. When observed, high-confidence special cause detected. Rule equation: |x - μ| > 3σ.
semantic_meaning.rank_1_rule_2: Rule 2: P(9 consecutive points same side of center) = 0.195% under normal. Signals sustained shift. Equation: all_of(points[i..i+8]) above_or_below(μ).
semantic_meaning.rank_1_rule_3: Rule 3: P(6 consecutive increasing/decreasing) = 0.78% under random walk. Signals monotonic trend. Equation: monotonic_sequence_length >= 6.
semantic_meaning.rank_2_domain_contract: SPC alert → autonomic healing penalty: each violation triggers -0.3 reward (capped at -1.5 for multiple). Proves RL agent receives signal when process misbehaves.
semantic_meaning.chicago_tdd_binding: Event log: each span = timestamped violation detection event. Aggregate → SPC timeline. Compare against declared process expectations (control limits should match process design).

status.description: SPC violations are always error-class events (special cause detected)

rule_violated.description: Which Western Electric rule was triggered

metric_monitored.description: Which process metric triggered the violation

metric_value.description: Observed value of the metric at violation time
metric_value.units: metric-dependent: event_rate in events/hour, trace_duration in ms, activity_frequency in count

control_limit_mean.description: μ (mean) of baseline control chart (computed from first 30 cycles)

control_limit_stddev.description: σ (standard deviation) of baseline control chart

z_score.description: Z-score of metric_value: (metric_value - mean) / stddev. Rule 1 threshold: |z| > 3. Rank-1 oracle evidence.

rule_2_consecutive_count.description: For Rule 2: count of consecutive points on same side of mean at violation time. Threshold: >= 9.

rule_2_side.description: For Rule 2: which side of control line the streak is on

rule_3_monotonic_sequence_length.description: For Rule 3: count of consecutive increasing or decreasing points. Threshold: >= 6.

rule_3_direction.description: For Rule 3: direction of monotonic trend

reward_penalty_applied.description: Reward penalty applied to RL agent as consequence: -0.3 per alert, capped at -1.5 for multiple alerts in same cycle

total_alerts_this_cycle.description: Total SPC violations in this cycle (affects penalty capping). Multiple Rules can fire in same cycle.

control_chart_history_length.description: How many points in the ring buffer at time of violation (max 100, min 1)

process_capability_estimate.description: Cpk estimate if sufficient samples exist (min 30). Cpk = min((USL-μ)/3σ, (μ-LSL)/3σ). Indicates process centering and spread. High Cpk = process stable and well-controlled.

upper_control_limit.description: UCL = μ + 3σ for display and Rule 1 threshold

historical_violation_count_metric.description: Total count of violations on this metric since orchestrator start (for trend analysis)

jaeger_query_pattern.description: How to extract SPC violation timeline for Chicago TDD Rank-1 oracle (Western Electric rules are mathematical).

query_examples.name: Rule 1 Outlier Timeline
query_examples.extraction: Extract [cycle_count, metric_value, z_score, metric_monitored] → plot z_score timeline
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-1: for each violation, |z_score| > 3.0 should be true (mathematical theorem: if |z| > 3, rare event detected)

query_examples.name: Rule 2 Consecutive Streak Detection
query_examples.extraction: Extract [cycle_count, rule_2_consecutive_count, rule_2_side, metric_monitored] per violation
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-1: for each span, rule_2_consecutive_count >= 9 (definition check); all 9 points should be on same_side=rule_2_side (monotonicity theorem)

query_examples.name: Rule 3 Monotonic Trend Detection
query_examples.extraction: Extract [cycle_count, rule_3_monotonic_sequence_length, rule_3_direction, metric_value] per violation
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-1: for each span, rule_3_monotonic_sequence_length >= 6; re-compute metric sequence over last 6 points, verify direction matches rule_3_direction (monotonic sequence theorem)

query_examples.name: RL Reward Penalty Causality (Rank-2 Domain Contract)
query_examples.jaeger_query: service.name:wpm AND span.name:"autonomic.spc_rule_violation" AND reward_penalty_applied AND cycle_count
query_examples.extraction: For each violation cycle: extract [cycle_count, reward_penalty_applied] → join with rl.convergence_diagnostics on cycle_count → verify reward decreased by penalty amount
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-2 Domain Contract: if reward_penalty_applied = -0.3 for this cycle, then reward[this_cycle] should equal reward[previous_cycle] - 0.3 (assuming no other reward components)

query_examples.name: Sustained SPC Violations (Multi-cycle Pattern)
query_examples.extraction: Group violations by metric_monitored. For each metric: list [cycle_count, rule_violated] in order. Compute MTBF (mean time between failures), rolling violation rate
query_examples.oracle_validation: Process stability: if MTBF < 50 cycles, process is out-of-control; RL agent should increase health degradation rate to prevent cascade

rule_1.statement: Under normal distribution, P(|x - μ| > 3σ) ≈ 0.27% (rare event). When observed, high confidence that special cause exists.
rule_1.wasm_binding: Compute |metric_value - control_limit_mean| / control_limit_stddev. If > 3.0, special cause detected by Rank-1 mathematical criterion.
rule_1.span_proof: z_score attribute directly encodes this calculation. Jaeger query validates: all rule_1_outlier spans have |z_score| > 3.0 (no false positives)

rule_2.statement: P(9 consecutive points on same side of μ) = 0.195% under random variation. When observed, sustained shift (not random noise).
rule_2.wasm_binding: Count consecutive points where sign(metric_value - μ) is constant. If >= 9, shift detected.
rule_2.span_proof: rule_2_consecutive_count attribute; Jaeger aggregates: all rule_2 spans have count >= 9, proving shift happened

rule_3.statement: P(6 consecutive monotonic points) = 0.78% under random walk. When observed, sustained trend (not oscillation).
rule_3.wasm_binding: Count consecutive points where metric[i] < metric[i+1] (or > for decreasing). If >= 6, trend detected.
rule_3.span_proof: rule_3_monotonic_sequence_length attribute; all rule_3 spans have length >= 6; direction verified

rank_2_domain_contract.contract: SPC Violation → RL Reward Penalty Mapping
rank_2_domain_contract.statement: Each SPC rule violation triggers a -0.3 reward penalty (capped at -1.5 for multiple violations in one cycle). This proves RL agent receives signal when process degrades.
rank_2_domain_contract.binding: SPC violation span → RL convergence span (same cycle). Join: cycle_count. If SPC span exists, check reward_mean_window in convergence span should show -0.3 dip.
rank_2_domain_contract.validation: Jaeger query: find all cycles with SPC violations, then cross-reference rl.convergence_diagnostics cumulative_reward trajectory. Violations should correlate with reward drops.

fm5_prevention.risk: Self-referential Rule 1 check: implement formula z = (x - μ)/σ, then test z > 3 by recomputing same formula
fm5_prevention.blocked_pattern: Do NOT derive z_score inside span from metric_value using control_limit_mean/stddev, then check |z| > 3
fm5_prevention.correct_approach: Compute z_score during SPC detection logic (separate from span). Span includes both metric_value, mean, stddev, AND z_score as independent measurements. Oracle is mathematical theorem (normal distribution property), not code logic.
fm5_prevention.validation: Jaeger: independently recompute z = (metric_value - control_limit_mean) / control_limit_stddev from span attributes. Should equal z_score attribute (verification, not derivation)

circuit_breaker_decision_impact.category: Circuit Breaker State Machine (Category D: FSM Correctness)
circuit_breaker_decision_impact.oracle_type: Rank-2 Domain Contract (circuit state rules) + Rank-3 Metamorphic Relation (decision → health/reward outcome)

emission_frequency.interval_cycles: On-demand (every allow_request() call that results in state transition)
trigger_conditions: State transition: Closed → Open (failure threshold exceeded)
State transition: Open → HalfOpen (timeout expired, probe allowed)
Decision blocks request: Open state denies request (not state change, but decision impact)

sampling_window.success_window: Last 3 consecutive successes in HalfOpen state (for recovery validation)

circuit_breaker_decision_impact.description: Span emitted on each circuit breaker decision that impacts RL agent health or reward. Captures decision logic (state, timeout, elapsed time), outcome (allow/deny), and downstream impact on health/reward. Evidence layer for proving circuit breaker FSM correctness and causality to RL reward per Rank-2 domain contract.

semantic_meaning.rank_2_domain_contract: Circuit breaker is autonomous healing guard: Closed allows work (normal), Open blocks work (protection), HalfOpen probes recovery. Each state has well-defined transition conditions (mathematical thresholds: failure_count >= threshold, elapsed >= timeout_ms, success_count >= 3).
semantic_meaning.rank_3_metamorphic: Decision open_blocks_request → health_degradation, decision_allows_recovery → health_improvement. Span captures decision; downstream RL reward cycle shows impact (decrease vs increase).
semantic_meaning.chicago_tdd_binding: Event log: each span = decision point in autonomic healing timeline. Aggregate spans → full FSM trace. Validate FSM never violates state machine rules (e.g., Closed→Open valid, Closed→HalfOpen invalid).
semantic_meaning.failure_detection: Invalid state transitions, timeout check failed (elapsed < threshold but transition occurred), inconsistent decision (allows_request=true in Open state with elapsed < timeout)

status.description: Decision status: 'ok' = normal state/allowed request, 'error' = blocked/state failure
status.semantics: ok = request allowed or normal closed state, error = request denied or open/halfopen state

current_state_after.description: Circuit breaker state after decision (same as before if no transition)

transition_direction.description: Direction of state transition (none if no transition)

decision_allows_request.description: True if request is allowed to proceed, false if blocked

decision_reason.description: Reason for decision per circuit breaker FSM rules

failure_count.description: Consecutive failure count at decision time. Threshold for Closed→Open transition: >= 3 (configurable)

success_count.description: Consecutive success count in HalfOpen state. Threshold for HalfOpen→Closed recovery: >= 3

elapsed_ms_since_state_change.description: Milliseconds elapsed since last state change. Used for timeout-based transitions (Rank-1 verification: elapsed >= timeout_threshold).

timeout_threshold_ms.description: Timeout threshold for current state. Closed=∞ (no timeout), Open=60000ms (1 min), HalfOpen=30000ms (30 sec).

timeout_comparison_result.description: Result of timeout check: elapsed_ms_since_state_change >= timeout_threshold_ms. Rank-1 oracle evidence (FM-5 prevention: include comparison operands).

request_impact_on_health.description: Expected health impact if request proceeds (improvement) vs blocked (degradation). Metamorphic oracle: Open blocks (healing), HalfOpen probe allows (testing recovery).

request_impact_on_reward.description: Expected reward impact of this decision. Allow in Closed: +0.1 (guard pass). Block in Open: -0.5 (guard fail).

failure_mode.description: Classification of failure (if transition to Open occurred). Examples: 'timeout_exceeded', 'exception_thrown', 'response_invalid', 'resource_exhausted'

recovery_probe_result.description: For HalfOpen → Closed/Open transitions: result of recovery probe attempt

health_level_before_decision.description: RL agent health state before this decision. Allows correlation between circuit breaker state and agent health (metamorphic: Open state should correlate with health >=2 (warning/critical))

health_level_predicted_after.description: Predicted health after this decision propagates (domain contract: allow → health improves, block → health degrades)

spc_alert_level_at_decision.description: SPC alert level when circuit decision made. Correlation: high SPC + Open state indicates process problem

jaeger_query_pattern.description: How to extract circuit FSM timeline for Chicago TDD Rank-2 domain contract validation.

query_examples.name: State Machine Trace (Rank-2 FSM Correctness)
query_examples.extraction: Extract [cycle_count, current_state_before, current_state_after, transition_direction] sorted by cycle_count ASC
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-2: validate all transitions are legal per FSM rules. Closed→Open (failure), Open→HalfOpen (timeout), HalfOpen→Closed/Open (recovery). Reject: Closed→HalfOpen (invalid), any bidirectional arrows except defined transitions

query_examples.name: Timeout Validation (Rank-1 Mathematical)
query_examples.extraction: For each timeout-triggered transition: extract [elapsed_ms_since_state_change, timeout_threshold_ms, timeout_comparison_result]
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-1: for each transition, timeout_comparison_result should equal (elapsed_ms >= timeout_threshold_ms). Recompute independently; if any mismatch, timeout logic bug detected (FM-5 prevention: don't trust timeout_comparison_result alone; verify arithmetic)

query_examples.name: Decision-to-Health Causality (Rank-3 Metamorphic)
query_examples.extraction: For each decision: get [cycle_count, decision_allows_request, request_impact_on_health] → join with rl.convergence_diagnostics on cycle_count+1 (next cycle) → extract health level → verify impact matched
query_examples.oracle_validation: Rank-3 Metamorphic: if request_impact_on_health = 'improvement', health[next_cycle] >= health[this_cycle]. If 'degradation', health[next_cycle] <= health[this_cycle] (property holds across execution, not assertion from code)

query_examples.name: Failure Recovery Success Rate
query_examples.extraction: Count [recovery_probe_result = 'success'] / [all recovery_probe_result], grouped by time window (e.g., every 100 cycles)
query_examples.oracle_validation: Process stability: if recovery success rate < 30%, healing is ineffective; agent should escalate to manual intervention

query_examples.name: Closed State Duration (MTBF - Mean Time Between Failures)
query_examples.jaeger_query: service.name:wpm AND span.name:"autonomic.circuit_breaker_decision_impact" AND transition_direction:"closed_to_open" OR "none" AND current_state_before:"Closed"
query_examples.extraction: Identify all cycles where state is Closed. Calculate duration between Closed→Open transitions.
query_examples.oracle_validation: System stability: MTBF should be >100 cycles (stable process). If MTBF < 50 cycles, process is in chronic failure; escalate

rank_2_oracle_proof.definition: 3-state FSM with well-defined transitions: (Closed, fail)→Open, (Open, timeout)→HalfOpen, (HalfOpen, success>=3)→Closed, (HalfOpen, failure)→Open, no other transitions valid.
rank_2_oracle_proof.wasm_binding: Each decision span includes [current_state_before, transition_direction]. Valid transitions: closed_to_open, open_to_halfopen, halfopen_to_closed, halfopen_to_open, none. Invalid: closed_to_halfopen, any cycle/jump.
rank_2_oracle_proof.span_proof: Jaeger trace: extract all transitions, verify none are invalid. If any invalid transition found, FSM implementation has bug (Rank-2 contract violated)

rank_3_oracle_proof.property: Metamorphic Relation: Circuit Decision → Health Impact
rank_3_oracle_proof.statement: Open state blocks requests (healing/protection); closed state allows (normal operation). Health should degrade when blocked (circuit healing), improve when recovery succeeds.
rank_3_oracle_proof.binding: For each circuit decision span: capture decision_allows_request, health_level_before_decision. On next cycle, check actual health_level. Expected: decision=allow → health increase, decision=block → health decrease.
rank_3_oracle_proof.span_proof: Metamorphic: run two circuits with different failure counts (same environment otherwise). Circuit A fails at cycle 50, Circuit B at cycle 100. Both should show same health/reward patterns relative to failure point (property-based, not assertion-based)

fm5_prevention.risk: Self-referential timeout check: implement elapsed >= threshold, then test timeout_comparison_result == (elapsed >= threshold)
fm5_prevention.blocked_pattern: Do NOT compute timeout_comparison_result from elapsed_ms_since_state_change and timeout_threshold_ms inside span logic
fm5_prevention.correct_approach: Capture elapsed_ms, timeout_threshold_ms, and timeout_comparison_result as independent attributes. Oracle is external (timeout is business rule), not code-derived.
fm5_prevention.validation: Jaeger: for each span, independently recompute (elapsed >= threshold). Should match timeout_comparison_result. If mismatch, timeout calculation bug found (but FM-5 avoided because oracle is independent)

cross_span_correlation.temporal_ordering: Spans should be emitted in strict cycle order: (1) RL convergence every 10 cycles, (2) SPC violations on-demand, (3) Circuit decisions on-demand. Jaeger query by cycle_count to establish causality.
cross_span_correlation.reward_flow_tracking: Health → SPC violation → reward penalty → RL convergence. Track single reward value across all three spans in same cycle to prove end-to-end causality.
cross_span_correlation.agent_health_timeline: RL convergence (health_improvement_rate) + SPC violations (metric_trends) + Circuit decisions (state_transitions) together form agent's autonomic healing story. Jaeger can join on cycle_count to correlate.
cross_span_correlation.chicago_tdd_integration: Three spans are independent OTEL evidence. Together, they form OCEL event log proof that autonomic healing occurred (or didn't). Process mining: discover actual healing process from logs, compare against declared FSM rules.

implementation_readiness.scope: Schema specification only; no code generation, no rustc modifications required
next_steps: Phase 1 (Cycle 3): Implement span emission in wasm4pm/src/rl_orchestrator.rs (RL convergence spans)
Phase 2 (Cycle 3): Implement span emission in wasm4pm/src/spc.rs (SPC rule classification spans)
Phase 3 (Cycle 3): Enhance wasm4pm/src/self_healing.rs with decision impact attributes (circuit breaker spans)
Phase 4 (Cycle 4): Add Jaeger query patterns to .claude/rules/_JAEGER_QUERY_PATTERNS.md
Phase 5 (Cycle 4): Write integration tests validating all 3 span types emit with correct attributes
implementation_readiness.test_harness_required: Chicago TDD oracle validators (Rank-1 mathematical, Rank-2 domain contract, Rank-3 metamorphic) must be implemented in test suite to validate spans during test execution

design_notes.why_three_spans: Autonomic healing has three independent but coordinated subsystems: (1) RL agent learning (convergence diagnostics), (2) process monitoring (SPC detection), (3) failure protection (circuit breaker). Each span type covers one subsystem's observability needs.
design_notes.why_rank_oracles: Chicago TDD doctrine: no claim is valid without Rank-1+ oracle (mathematical proof). Rank-4 statistical for RL (convergence proven via multiple seeds), Rank-1 for SPC (Western Electric rules are theorems), Rank-2 for circuit (FSM is domain contract).
design_notes.why_jaeger_patterns: Proof is not in individual spans, but in aggregate traces. Jaeger queries show causality and compliance with declared rules. Each query pattern maps to one oracle validation.
design_notes.fm5_blocking: Three FM-5 prevention sections in each span prevent self-referential test traps. Example: TD error span includes raw metrics (td_error_mean, convergence_ratio), not 'expected_ratio_from_formula'. Oracle is external mathematical theorem, not implementation logic.
design_notes.why_optional_attributes: Some attributes are diagnostic (health_level_before_decision) but not required for oracle validation. Optional attributes aid root-cause analysis without bloating required contract.
